name: world agent-pass device flow
note: Authored from https://auth.world.org/docs/guides/oidc ('Device Authorization Grant', 'Device flow', the poll-response table) and https://auth.world.org/docs/guides/step-up ('Accept Orb or Selfie Check'): the exact form fields services/api/src/world-agent-pass.ts sends and the answers it handles. Nothing here was recorded against auth.world.org (no client registered yet); the local simulator (LocalIdp) answers with these shapes and services/api/test/agent-pass.test.ts drives every one of them. Re-record with the registered client.

exchanges.name: start (RFC 8628 §3.1) — client_secret_post, essential acr through claims

form.nonce: <32 hex, fresh per attempt; the docs say device tokens omit it>

body.device_code: <private; stays in the API's sealed state, never returned or logged>

exchanges.name: poll — too fast (add five seconds to every later interval)
poll — the human cancelled or the essential acr was not met (stop; denied)
poll — the 20-minute attempt lifetime passed (stop; expired)
poll — approved; the ID token is validated in the backend before anything is armed

response.note: No nonce in a device-grant ID token ('accept its absence for this profile'). The API checks alg, signature (JWKS kid), iss, aud, exp, iat, acr in WORLD_AGENT_PASS_ACR, auth_time within WORLD_AGENT_PASS_MAX_AGE_S, one use (jti), and the policy's bound (iss, sub).

exchanges.name: private_key_jwt alternative (RFC 7523) — the same two requests with an assertion instead of the secret

form.client_assertion: <fresh RS256 JWT per request: iss=sub=client id, aud=the endpoint, iat, exp ≤ iat+3600, unique jti, kid of the registered public JWKS>
